Name: Jake the Dog - Dog Replacer CONTENT PATCHER
Author: alphadawgy
Description:
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/2nYtJ3J.png[/img][/u][font=Verdana][size=6]JAKE THE DOG [/size][/font]
[u]MOD[/u]
[size=3]A simple mod that replaces the german shepherd-like dog breed with Jake the Dog from Adventure Time.
It's certainly him, though it does not change any sound effects, nor is he a special character, or have any magical powers to shapeshift.
Here, he is just a dog, but I hope you enjoy.
[/size]
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.


[/list][u][size=5]How to get him ingame
[/size][/u][size=3]On a new game, when you are making your farmer, be sure you pick the shepherd dog (the one with pointed ears).[/size][size=3]If you didn't pick the german shepherd dog but would like him in your game, you have a couple options.
You can change it at the [i]Wizard's Shrine[/i] (small fee), [b][i]or[/i][/b] you can edit the [i]"content.json"[/i] found within the mod folder to refer the ([i]animals/dog[/i]) or ([i]animals/dog2[/i]) as opposed to the dog1. If you didn't choose a dog, I'd find another mod to help you on that.

[u][size=5]Bugs
[/size][/u]None that I know of but if there any issues of the mod not loading properly
or the sprite glitching, let me know and I'll fix it as soon as I can.[/size]

[u]Credits[/u]
Adventure Time / Jake the Dog belongs to Pendleton ward and the Cartoon Network.
Pixel artwork is done by me.
Do not reupload to other sites.
